title: PRISMATECH X IMPERIAL FASHION X CLO Brand Story
description: PRISMATECH X IMPERIAL FASHION X CLO Brand Story
transcript:
I am Luca Lazzari, responsible for production and clothing at Ita Imperia.  
Imperia is a leading company in fast fashion. Its main characteristic is production in a short time. From the stylist’s creation to the delivery of the finished product, only seven days pass on average. The continuous search for innovation by the owner has allowed us to develop increasingly complex and advanced technological systems. We have seen various 3D solutions, but CLAW impressed us for its ease of use and for the possibility of creating the entire chain, from commercial to style to modeling. Depending on the departments where CLAW 3D has been used, we immediately achieved satisfactory results within a few months. The CLAW 3D program has enabled us to make decisions much more quickly and with a much lower margin of error.  

I am Angelo Mastri, a men’s and women’s modeler at Imperial. I started my work in 1985, when everything was still handmade and models were made on cardboard. I joined Imperial at the end of 2016, and on that occasion I saw CLAW’s 3D system for the first time. We immediately began working on the 3D project, with unexpected results for me from the very first weeks. Today, at the Pattern Office, we have three CLAW CAD workstations. We work in close contact with stylists. By using the 2D part of the CLAW system, we can modify volumes, lengths, and details in real time. Everything that was previously done manually, we can now do in 3D. In summary, we have significantly shortened design times by optimizing the final result and practically reducing errors to zero. The future is in the hands of 3D technology.

chunks.content: # PRISMATECH X IMPERIAL FASHION X CLAW Brand Story ## Introduction to Imperial Fashion and Fast Fashion Production This section introduces Imperial Fashion, a leading fast fashion company specializing in rapid production cycles and innovation in garment manufacturing. Key terms include fast fashion, production time, and technological innovation. I am Luca Lazzari, responsible for production and clothing at Ita Imperia. Imperial Fashion is a leading company in fast fashion, characterized by its exceptionally short production timeline. From the stylist’s initial creation to the delivery of the finished product, the process takes only seven days on average. This rapid cycle is a core competitive advantage in the fast fashion industry. The company’s continuous pursuit of innovation, driven by its owner, has led to the development of increasingly complex and advanced technological systems to streamline production. Over time, Imperial evaluated various 3D solutions, ultimately selecting the CLAW 3D system for its ease of use and comprehensive capabilities. CLAW supports the entire production chain, from commercial planning and styling to modeling. By integrating CLAW 3D into different departments, Imperial achieved satisfactory results within a few months. The system has enabled faster decision-making and significantly reduced errors, improving overall production efficiency. ## CLAW 3D System Implementation and Impact on Pattern Making This section details the adoption of CLAW 3D technology at Imperial Fashion, focusing on its role in pattern making, collaboration between departments, and improvements in design accuracy and speed. Important terms include CLAW CAD, 3D technology, modeling, and design optimization. I am Angelo Mastri, a men’s and women’s modeler at Imperial. I began my career in 1985 when all patterns were handmade and created on cardboard. I joined Imperial at the end of 2016, where I encountered the CLAW 3D system for the first time. We immediately started integrating CLAW into our workflow, and the results exceeded expectations from the very first weeks. Currently, the Pattern Office is equipped with three CLAW CAD workstations. This setup allows close collaboration with stylists. Using the 2D module of CLAW, we can modify garment volumes, lengths, and details in real time. Tasks that were previously manual are now fully digital and executed within the 3D environment. This transition has significantly shortened design times, optimized the final product, and virtually eliminated errors. The successful adoption of CLAW 3D technology highlights the future direction of garment production at Imperial, emphasizing the critical role of 3D tools in fast fashion and pattern making. --- *End of document.*
